english.errors.QUIT_NOTICE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: An unresolved shutdown or fault notice requires review before spending or reopening. Review and acknowledge the notice first; preserved runtime and evidence files remain untouched.
english.errors.NOTICE_PERSIST_FAILED: The wallet could not record the shutdown fault notice on disk. Ownership is retained and the window stays open; retry recording or, if Core is stopped, confirm exit without recording.
english.errors.MANAGED_DEAD_OWNER_RECOVERY_REQUI: The original owned Core process exited unexpectedly. No foreign process will be adopted or terminated. Use the explicit recover-and-restart action for this original owner before continuing or quitting.
english.errors.MANAGED_SHUTDOWN_UNCERTAIN: Core stop outcome is uncertain and the original process may still be running. Ownership is retained and no termination signal will be sent; wait and check Core before retrying Quit.
english.errors.MANAGED_STOP_NOT_DELIVERED: Core stop could not be delivered and the original process may still be running. Ownership is retained and no termination signal will be sent; check Core status before retrying Quit.
english.errors.MANAGED_LIVE_OWNER_CLOSE_DENIED: Core is still running, so the wallet cannot close yet. Stop Core cleanly before exiting.
english.errors.QUIT_ACK_UNRECORDED_NOT_PENDING: No unrecorded quit notice is pending.
english.errors.QUIT_NOTICE_RETRY_NOT_PENDING: No failed quit notice is awaiting retry.
english.quit_lifecycle.runtime_preserved_body: Owned Core stopped, but wallet session cleanup did not finish cleanly. Local runtime and reservation evidence were preserved on disk and will require review on next launch. Never delete wallet files.
english.quit_lifecycle.unresolved_body: A previous session recorded an unresolved fault or shutdown notice. Review the summary below and acknowledge before continuing. Preserved evidence files are never deleted automatically.
english.quit_lifecycle.unresolved_acked_status: Unresolved notices acknowledged. Preserved evidence remains on disk for review.
english.quit_lifecycle.persist_failed_title: Fault notice could not be recorded
english.quit_lifecycle.persist_failed_body_stopp: Core stopped, but the fault notice could not be saved to disk. Ownership is retained so the state is not lost. Retry recording the notice, or confirm exiting without recording a notice.
english.quit_lifecycle.persist_failed_body_live: Core may still be running and the fault notice could not be saved to disk. Exit is blocked until Core stops cleanly and the notice is recorded or acknowledged.
english.quit_lifecycle.exit_unrecorded_confirm_b: No fault notice was saved to disk; the next launch will rely on preserved runtime, failure and journal files alone. Core is stopped. Confirm exiting without recording this notice?
english.quit_lifecycle.dead_owner_body: The original owned Core process exited before shutdown completed. No foreign process will be adopted or terminated. Explicitly recover and restart the original Core owner before continuing or quitting.
english.quit_lifecycle.status_blocked_live: Exit blocked: owned Core may still be running. No termination signal will be sent.
